knowledge:
- key_parameters: M=Mutation count matrix of samples x 96 features ;; Opport=Opportunity matrix containing count frequency of features in the analyzed region (highly recommended for normalization) ;; nsig=Fixed number of signatures to estimate (makes the algorithm faster) ;; nlim=Interval of possible numbers of signatures to search for the optimal rank ;; P=Matrix of known signatures used as starting values or fixed parameters ;; fixedP=Logical; if TRUE, keeps P constant during exposure estimation (fitting), if FALSE, uses P as a starting point ;; main_eval=Number of final Gibbs sampler iterations used to estimate signatures and exposures ;; EM_eval=Number of iterations performed to estimate the hyper-hyper parameters of the model ;; EMit_lim=EM iteration limit ;; testing_burn=Number of burn-in iterations used to estimate the number of signatures (default 1000) ;; testing_eval=Number of evaluation iterations used to estimate the number of signatures (default 1000) ;; labels=Vector of group labels for differential exposure analysis or sample classification ;; method=Classification algorithm (e.g., "knn", "lvq", "logreg", "lda", "lasso", "nb", "svm", "rf", "ab") or survival method ("logrank", "cox")
- alternatives: The documentation mentions "EMu" as a probabilistic inference method for mutational processes.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have somatic single nucleotide variation (SNV) data from cancer genomes and want to discover de novo mutational signatures, estimate exposures to known signatures (e.g., COSMIC), and correlate these exposures with clinical metadata, survival data, or sample groups.
- pitfalls: OS X users may experience compilation errors due to missing gfortran libraries and must install them manually. Missing 3rd party library headers like libcurl4-openssl-dev or libopenblas-dev can cause installation failures. Fuzzy clustering (FuzzyClustExp) can be a long process and demands high computer resources. Generating count matrices from VCF/MAF or opportunity matrices from genomes requires the corresponding BSgenome package to be installed.

workflows.name: de_novo_signature_discovery
workflows.intent: Generate mutation count and opportunity matrices from genomic variants, estimate the optimal number of mutational signatures, and perform de novo signature discovery and exposure visualization.
input: target.bed (BED file containing the genomic regions analyzed by the variant caller)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate mutation count matrix from VCF using genCountMatrixFromVcf ;; 2. Generate opportunity matrix from reference genome and target regions using genOpportunityFromGenome ;; 3. Run signeR to estimate signatures and exposures ;; 4. Plot BIC values to evaluate the optimal number of signatures using BICboxplot ;; 5. Plot MCMC paths, signatures, and exposures using Paths, SignPlot, SignHeat, ExposureBoxplot, ExposureBarplot, and ExposureHeat
workflows.code:
library(VariantAnnotation)
# BSgenome, equivalent to the one used on the variant call
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19)
vcfobj <- readVcf("/path/to/a/file.vcf", "hg19")
mut <- genCountMatrixFromVcf(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19, vcfobj)
library(rtracklayer)
target_regions <- import(con="/path/to/a/target.bed", format="bed")
opp <- genOpportunityFromGenome(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg19,
    target_regions, nsamples=nrow(mut))
signatures <- signeR(M=mut, Opport=opp, nsig=3, main_eval=100, EM_eval=50, EMit_lim=20)
BICboxplot(signatures)
Paths(signatures$SignExposures)
SignPlot(signatures$SignExposures)
SignHeat(signatures$SignExposures)
ExposureBoxplot(signatures$SignExposures)
ExposureBarplot(signatures$SignExposures)
ExposureBarplot(signatures$SignExposures, relative=TRUE)
ExposureHeat(signatures$SignExposures)

workflows.name: exposure_estimation_to_known_signatures
workflows.intent: Estimate sample exposures to a set of predefined, known mutational signatures (e.g., COSMIC signatures) while keeping the signatures fixed.
workflows.stages: 1. Read mutation counts and opportunity matrices from files ;; 2. Read known signatures matrix ;; 3. Run signeR with fixedP=TRUE to estimate exposures to known signatures ;; 4. Extract median exposures using Median_exp

workflows.name: downstream_exposure_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform supervised and unsupervised analyses on estimated exposures, including differential exposure analysis, sample classification, correlation, survival analysis, and clustering.
input: SignExposures (estimated exposures object from a prior signeR run)
BRCA_labels (vector of categorical group labels for samples)
myFeature (vector of continuous feature values for samples)
su (matrix containing survival time and status for samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Perform Differential Exposure Analysis using DiffExp ;; 2. Classify unlabeled samples using ExposureClassify ;; 3. Evaluate correlation with continuous features using ExposureCorrelation and ExposureGLM ;; 4. Perform survival analysis using ExposureSurvival (log-rank and Cox) and ExposureSurvModel ;; 5. Perform hierarchical and fuzzy clustering using HClustExp and FuzzyClustExp
workflows.code:
# group labels, respective to each row of the mutation count matrix
BRCA_labels <- c("wt","BRCA1+","BRCA2+","BRCA1+","BRCA2+","BRCA1+","BRCA1+",
    "wt","wt","wt","wt","BRCA1+","wt","BRCA2+","BRCA2+","wt","wt","wt",
    "wt","wt","wt")

diff_exposure <- DiffExp(signatures$SignExposures, labels=BRCA_labels)
diff_exposure$Pvquant
diff_exposure$MostExposed

# note that BRCA_labels [15],[20] and [21] are set to NA
BRCA_labels <- c("wt","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","wt","wt",
    "wt","wt","BRCA+","wt","BRCA+",NA,"wt","wt","wt","wt",NA,NA)

Class <- ExposureClassify(signatures$SignExposures, labels=BRCA_labels, method="knn")
Class$class
Class$freq
Class$allfreqs

# feature values, respective to each row of the mutation count matrix. 
# The feature simulated below will be correlated with exposures to signature 2.
myFeature <- (10^6)*Median_exp(signatures$SignExposures)[2,] + rnorm(21,0,1) 

ExpCorr <- ExposureCorrelation(signatures$SignExposures, feature=myFeature)
ExpLM <- ExposureGLM(signatures$SignExposures, feature=myFeature)

# survival times and censoring, respective to each row of the mutation count matrix. 
#Time is simulated so that it is correlated to exposures to signature 3.
critical_sig<-Median_exp(signatures$SignExposures)[2,]
probs<-(critical_sig-min(critical_sig))/(max(critical_sig)-min(critical_sig))
su<-as.matrix(data.frame(time=sample(80:150,21,replace=T),
                         status=sapply(probs,function(p){sample(c(0,1),1,prob=c(p,1-p))})))

ExpSurv <- ExposureSurvival(Exposures=signatures$SignExposures, 
                            surv=su, method="logrank")
ExpSurv.cox <- ExposureSurvival(Exposures=signatures$SignExposures, 
                                surv=su, method="cox")

BRCA_labels <- c("wt","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+","BRCA+",
    "wt","wt","wt","wt","BRCA+","wt","BRCA+","BRCA+","wt","wt","wt",
    "wt","wt","wt")

ExpSurvMd <- ExposureSurvModel(Exposures=signatures$SignExposures, surv=su, addata=data.frame(as.factor(BRCA_labels)))

# feature values, respective to each row of the mutation count matrix
HCE <- HClustExp(signatures$SignExposures,method.dist="euclidean", method.hclust="average")
FCE <- FuzzyClustExp(signatures$SignExposures, Clim=c(3,7))
